digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI, main text (+ Mgombato funga)

teaser.en: 'It ties up animals': a twining forest climber that grows so tangled it is said to snare any animal walking through.
teaser.sw: 'Hufunga wanyama': mtambaa wa msituni unaojiviringa na kusokotana kiasi kwamba husemekana kumnasa mnyama yeyote anayepita ndani yake.

summary.en: Mfunga nyama is a forest liana of the passion-flower family that twines so thickly it is said to tie up passing animals. It is also hard to identify, because its leaves change shape as it grows.
summary.sw: Mfunga nyama ni mtambaa wa msituni wa familia ya mkarakara (passion flower) unaojiviringa kwa wingi kiasi kwamba husemekana kuwafunga wanyama wanaopita. Pia ni mgumu kuutambua, kwa sababu majani yake hubadilika umbo unavyokua.

about.en: Mfunga nyama is a slender shrub that becomes a small liana up to about three metres, climbing with tendrils from the upper leaf axils. It is hairless and grows from a perennial rootstock. The leaves change a great deal with age. Seedlings and young plants have small, deeply cut leaves, while mature plants have larger leaves with toothed edges. The flowers grow in short clusters near the branch tips. Each has a ring of many slender, tapering filaments (a corona), as in a passion flower. The fruit is a three- or four-valved capsule.
about.sw: Mfunga nyama ni kichaka chembamba kinachogeuka kuwa mtambaa mdogo wa hadi mita tatu hivi, kikipanda kwa vikonyo vinavyotoka kwenye kwapa za majani ya juu. Hakina manyoya na huota kutoka kwenye shina-mzizi linalodumu miaka mingi. Majani hubadilika sana kadiri unavyozeeka. Miche na mimea michanga ina majani madogo yaliyokatwa kwa kina, wakati mimea iliyokomaa ina majani makubwa zaidi yenye meno pembeni. Maua huota katika vishada vifupi karibu na ncha za matawi. Kila ua lina duara la nyuzi nyingi nyembamba zinazochongoka (taji, corona), kama ilivyo kwa ua la pasheni. Tunda ni kibumba chenye vipande vitatu au vinne.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique and KwaZulu-Natal.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka nchini Kenya, Tanzania, Msumbiji na KwaZulu-Natal.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'ties animal'. The plant is said to grow in such a twining tangle that it ties up (*funga*) an animal (*nyama*) crossing through it. He groups it with other names describing vigorous growth, such as *mfunga sandzu*, and *mwambanyama*, the 'animal trapper' grass. He also notes that it is hard to identify, because its young and mature leaves look so different.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kuwa 'hufunga mnyama'. Inasemekana mmea huu hukua ukijiviringa na kusokotana kiasi kwamba humfunga (*funga*) mnyama (*nyama*) anayepita ndani yake. Anaupanga pamoja na majina mengine yanayoeleza ukuaji wa nguvu, kama *mfunga sandzu*, na *mwambanyama*, nyasi 'mtega wanyama'. Anabainisha pia kwamba ni mgumu kuutambua, kwa sababu majani yake machanga na yaliyokomaa yanatofautiana sana.

names.en: Digo: *mfunga nyama*, 'ties animal'. Mgombato gives *funga* as 'to close, to tie'. Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name. It is the only species in the genus *Schlechterina*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfunga nyama*, 'hufunga mnyama'. Mgombato anatoa *funga* kwa maana ya 'kufunga'. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. Ndiyo spishi pekee katika jenasi *Schlechterina*.

reason.en: Adenia gummifera, another climber of the passion-flower family
reason.sw: Adenia gummifera, mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya mkarakara

reason.en: Adenia kirkii, in the same family
reason.sw: Adenia kirkii, wa familia hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Itch grass, the 'animal trapper', named the same way
reason.sw: Itch grass, 'mtega wanyama', uliopewa jina kwa namna hiyo hiyo

mgombato: funga 1) to close, to tie; kufunga.
